nodes.description: Private owner address set in the constructor; sole privilege holder for delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and a whitelist bypass in ensure.
Owner-controlled address that is unconditionally whitelisted by ensure.
Public mapping of token balances read and mutated with raw arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spend allowances mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Owner-controlled whitelist mapping consulted by ensure to bypass sale restrictions.
Minimum sale amount enforced by condition, set in init.
Maximum sale amount enforced by condition, set in init.
Maximum number of sales per address enforced by condition, set in init.
Public total supply assigned in the constructor.
Constant 18 used to scale supply and sale limits.
Hard-coded constant router address that is always whitelisted by ensure.
Private mapping of balances in the ERC20 base contract.
Private nested mapping of allowances in the ERC20 base contract.
Private total supply of the ERC20 base contract.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transfer path that checks allowance, calls ensure, and mutates balanceOf, allowance and _onSaleNum using raw unchecked arithmetic.
Internal view whitelist gate returning true for owner, the caller's UNI router, tradeAddress, canSale addresses or the computed pair, otherwise delegating to condition.
Internal view sale-limit check enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public payable approval writing allowance for msg.sender.
Owner-only function performing a delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only initializer that scales sale limits by decimals using raw multiplication.
Owner-only batch distribution that computes total = _value * _tos.length and credits each recipient with checked-by-require but raw arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure CREATE2-style Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure.
Payable constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender, sets owner and pre-approves the hard-coded router.
Standard ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer with _msgSender.
Standard ERC20 transferFrom using SafeMath for allowance bookkeeping.
Standard ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
Internal ERC20 balance movement using SafeMath and zero-address checks.
Internal mint updating _totalSupply and _balances.
Internal burn updating _balances and _totalSupply.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Checked addition library function.
Checked subtraction library function.
Checked multiplication library function.
Checked division library function.
Private helper performing a low-level call to an arbitrary token address and decoding optional return data.
Caller-supplied address used as the source of UniswapExchange.transfer.
Caller-supplied address compared against _from and used to index allowance in transferFrom.
Caller-supplied address that becomes the allowance owner in approve.
Caller-supplied address checked against owner before the delegatecall.
Caller-supplied address checked against owner before initializing sale limits.
Caller-supplied address checked against owner before batch distribution.
Caller-supplied address checked against owner before setting tradeAddress.

address(token).call(data) on a caller-supplied token address, enabling reentrancy or arbitrary calldata execution.

token * 10**uint256(decimals) and maxToken * 10**uint256(decimals) computed without SafeMath in init.

edges.reason: UniswapExchange.transfer forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source address.
transferFrom calls ensure to authorize the movement of tokens before mutating balances.
ensure falls back to condition; the whitelist gate decides who is allowed to sell, making it an access control decision point.
delegate performs a delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address with attacker-supplied calldata.
init computes token and maxToken scaled by 10**decimals with raw multiplication.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
batchSend credits balanceOf[_to] += _value inside a loop with raw unchecked addition.
transferFrom debits balanceOf[_from] with raw subtraction instead of SafeMath.
transferFrom credits balanceOf[_to] with raw addition instead of SafeMath.
transferFrom reduces allowance[_from][msg.sender] with raw subtraction.
callOptionalReturn performs address(token).call(data) on an external contract.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address used in the whitelist.
ERC20.transfer delegates balance movement to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates balance movement to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom updates allowances through _approve.
ERC20.approve delegates to _approve.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of the internal transferFrom call.
msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] and is compared with _from, gating the transfer.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner when approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing tokens.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before updating the whitelist address.
The owner state variable is the authorization condition guarding delegate.
The owner state variable is the authorization condition guarding init.
The owner state variable is the authorization condition guarding batchSend.
The owner state variable is the authorization condition guarding setTradeAddress.
ensure unconditionally returns true when _from or _to equals owner, bypassing all sale restrictions.
ensure whitelists the owner-controlled tradeAddress, bypassing sale restrictions.
ensure whitelists canSale[_from], an owner-controlled blacklist/whitelist gate.
ensure whitelists the hard-coded UNI router constant.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments the _onSaleNum counter for the sender.
condition enforces per-address sale counts using _onSaleNum.
condition enforces the _minSale threshold, restricting eligible sellers.
condition enforces the _maxSale threshold, restricting eligible sellers.
condition checks the global _saleNum limit before allowing a transfer.
batchSend reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for the sender and each recipient.
The constructor assigns totalSupply from the supplied _supply.
The constructor scales _supply by 10**decimals.
init scales token and maxToken by 10**decimals.
_transfer reads and writes the ERC20 _balances mapping.
_approve writes the ERC20 _allowances mapping.
_mint increases the ERC20 _totalSupply.
The caller-supplied _from parameter drives balance and sale-counter mutations in transferFrom.
The _to parameter receives the transferred balance in transferFrom.
The _value parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom.
_from determines the whitelist and condition outcome inside ensure.
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition via ensure.
The _tos array supplies recipients and its length scales the batchSend total.
The _value parameter is credited to each recipient by batchSend.
The computed _UNI pair address participates in the ensure whitelist.
The loop-local _to is the current recipient credited in batchSend.
The loop counter i iterates over the recipient array in batchSend.
The address parameter a is the target of the delegatecall in delegate.
The bytes parameter b is the calldata of the delegatecall in delegate.
The saleNum parameter is stored into the _saleNum state variable by init.
The token parameter sets _minSale in init.
The maxToken parameter sets _maxSale in init.
The local total is the result of the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length.
The local total is subtracted from the sender balance in batchSend.
The _to parameter is forwarded by transfer into transferFrom.
The _value parameter is forwarded by transfer into transferFrom.
The low-level call into an untrusted token contract hands control to external code that can re-enter SafeERC20 or ERC20 flows.
The delegatecall executes external code with this contract's storage and context, giving the callee full control over contract state.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter is exclusively consumed by UniswapExchange.transferFrom for whitelist checks and balance mutation.
The _to parameter is exclusively consumed by UniswapExchange.transferFrom as the balance recipient.
The _value parameter is exclusively consumed by UniswapExchange.transferFrom as the transferred amount.
The _tos array parameter only supplies recipients to UniswapExchange.batchSend.
The _value parameter only supplies the per-recipient amount to UniswapExchange.batchSend.
The local _UNI pair address is computed and used only inside UniswapExchange.ensure.
The loop-local _to exists only inside the UniswapExchange.batchSend loop.
The loop counter i exists only inside the UniswapExchange.batchSend loop.
The target address a is the untrusted argument of the unsafe delegatecall in UniswapExchange.delegate.
The calldata b is the untrusted argument of the unsafe delegatecall in UniswapExchange.delegate.
The saleNum parameter is only used to set the _saleNum state variable inside UniswapExchange.init.
The token parameter is only used to set the _minSale state variable inside UniswapExchange.init.
The maxToken parameter is only used to set the _maxSale state variable inside UniswapExchange.init.
The local total is the direct product of the unchecked multiplication classified as an unsafe arithmetic operation.
The _to parameter is only forwarded by UniswapExchange.transfer to transferFrom.
The _value parameter is only forwarded by UniswapExchange.transfer to transferFrom.
